triples.tail_surface: permanent, semi-permanent, or portable measuring equipment
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 永久、半永久或便携式测量设备
triples.evidence_text: Dynamic monitoring systems may collect data utilizing permanent, semi-permanent, or portable measuring equipment.
For permanently installed systems, the transducers, cabling, and associated signal processing and analyzing equipment are permanently installed with data collected continuously or periodically.

triples.tail_surface: machinery data are collected manually on a periodic basis
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 定期人工采集机械数据
triples.evidence_text: In portable measuring equipment, machinery data are collected manually on a periodic basis on pre-selected permanently marked or affixed locations.
Semi-permanent systems also utilize portable measurement equipment, although the sensors are permanently mounted due to safety or access concerns.

triples.tail_surface: operating conditions for the examined machinery
triples.evidence_text: Measurement results are affected by operating conditions for the examined machinery, operating machinery nearby, and weather and environmental conditions being experienced by the vessel.

triples.tail_surface: equipment and vessel being operated in a consistent manner
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设备和船舶以一致方式运行
triples.evidence_text: Therefore, successive measurements should be taken with the equipment and vessel being operated in a consistent manner as far as practicable.

triples.head_surface: Vibration measurement displacement probes, velocity sensors, and accelerometers
triples.head_canonical_zh: 振动测量位移探头、速度传感器和加速度计
triples.tail_surface: periodically check the calibration of the equipment
triples.evidence_text: However, it is necessary to periodically check the calibration of the equipment to verify proper operation, particularly if the equipment has been repaired or operated near its specified environmental limits.

triples.tail_surface: single or multi-frequency precision reference signal generator
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 单频或多频精密参考信号发生器
triples.evidence_text: A single or multi-frequency precision reference signal generator can be used to verify the signal processing equipment is measuring the frequency within its stated accuracy.

triples.head_surface: measurements of the precision reference are outside the accuracy limits
triples.head_canonical_zh: 精密参考测量超出精度限值
triples.tail_surface: sent to the manufacturer for calibration and repair
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 送制造商进行校准和维修
triples.evidence_text: If the measurements of the precision reference are outside the accuracy limits, then the equipment can be sent to the manufacturer for calibration and repair, if necessary.
